name: application-engine-templates
description: DOCX generation templates for resume/cover-letter skills

scripts.check-templates: node -c templates/_layout.js && for f in templates/resume-template.js templates/cover-letter-template.js templates/cold-outreach-letter-template.js templates/thank-you-letter-template.js; do node --check "$f" && echo "  ✓ $f" || { echo "  ✗ $f"; exit 1; }; done
scripts.check: npm run check-templates && npm run check-pii
